definitions.short: a heap of rubbish or filth
definitions.full: H830. ashpoth אַשְׁמֹּת noun [masculine] ash-heap(?), refuse-heap, dung-hill (probably originally fire-place stones , compare Arabic below √); — ׳א absolute as beggars' resting-place 1Sam 2:8 = Psa 113:7 (both || עָפָר ; compare Job 2:8 Wetzst in De); so plural אַשׁפַתּוֺת Lam 4:5 ; הָאַשְׁמֹּת שַׁעַר Neh 2:13 ; 3:14 ; 12:31 = ׳שׁ הָֽשְׁפוֺת 3:13 (Ges § 35d ).
definitions.rootNote: or אַשְׁפּוֹת ; or שְׁפֹת ; (contraction) plural of a noun of the same form as 827 , from 8192 (in the sense of scraping );
